title: Broken straight out of the box.
text: Broken straight out of the box.. The product arrived yesterday. I stored some coffee grounds in them overnight and by morning, there was no vacuum pressure remaining. After putting water in the container, sucking out the air and turning it over, I discovered the flaw is in the little bubble that lets you know it's been vacuumed. There's a hole in it that lets air in very slowly. I know the hole is in that membrane because when I put my finger over it, there's suction. Upon examining the rest of the containers, they seem fine. If you buy this product, make sure you test each container and lid before use.
